claims.value: An open vision-language model family by Ai2 supporting image, video, and multi-image understanding and grounding. Molmo2-8B is built on Qwen3-8B with a SigLIP 2 vision backbone.
claims.evidence: Molmo2 is a family of open vision-language models developed by the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) that support image, video and multi-image understanding and grounding.
